lines: The spiral staircase ends in a vast circular chamber. The walls curve inward overhead, converging on a point of absolute darkness at the apex — and within that darkness, a single point of light.
The Spire's resonance core. The geometric patterns on every surface pulse in rhythm with your sol unit, as if the ancient structure recognizes the technology you carry.
At the center of the chamber, a crystal pedestal rises from the floor. Its surface is covered in symbols you can't read — but the meaning is clear. This is an interface. It's waiting for you.
The spiral staircase ends in a vast circular chamber. The walls curve inward overhead, converging on a point of absolute darkness at the apex — and within that darkness, a single point of light.
The Spire's resonance core. The geometric patterns on every surface pulse in rhythm with your sol unit, as if the ancient structure recognizes the technology you carry.
At the center of the chamber, a crystal pedestal rises from the floor. Its surface is covered in symbols you can't read — but the meaning is clear. This is an interface. It's waiting for you.
You place your hand on the crystal pedestal. Your sol unit flares — painfully bright — and the entire chamber ignites.
Light erupts from every geometric groove, every symbol, every surface. The patterns converge on your sol unit and pour energy through it in a cascade that rewrites its base configuration.
For a moment you feel it — the Underlumen. A vast network beneath the planet's surface, ancient beyond reckoning. Not alive, exactly. But aware. Responding.

The torrent subsides. Your sol unit has changed. New patterns are etched into its housing, and a new ability thrums in its core: the power to deploy autonomous light. A sentry that holds ground for you.
The Spire of Vigil has given you what it was built to teach: spatial control through light. The ability to hold territory, to defend positions, to project presence beyond your own body.
LIGHT SENTRY UNLOCKED — deploy stationary sentries that target enemies with sustained beams.

actions.text: Return to Outpost Balor with the Spire data
The reconfigured Spire yields its reward — Underlumen components attuned to Normal resonance.
The Spire rewards your courage — rare components forged in the deeper resonance of Hard difficulty.
The Spire unleashes its deepest treasures — ancient components of extraordinary power, preserved since before human colonization.
The Spire offers one final gift — a cache of ancient components, preserved in crystal since before human colonization.
The cache is sealed behind crystal. The central pedestal must be activated first.
The resonance core pulses gently. The Spire's purpose is fulfilled — for now. Its inner chambers will reconfigure for those who return seeking greater challenges.
